description:
Outcome: Repairer finishes an active repair, from BRIEF.md.
Scope: API/UI state transition and completed visibility per T-002. Excludes: repair notes, payments and SMS.
Acceptance: Only an active repair transitions to finished; repeated requests preserve correct state; agreed display policy is applied.
Behaviour: Accessible pending state, confirmation and safe error/retry recovery.
Verification: API/UI integration tests with active-entry fixtures and invalid/repeated requests. Prerequisites: T-004; T-006 implementation is not required for fixtures. Assumptions: apply T-002 decisions.
title: Mark a repair finished end to end
